messages:
Maya: Quick check — Acme's vendor risk form has a weird data residency mismatch. Their questionnaire says "US + EU only" but the DPA draft we sent has "global processing" checkbox checked. Can legal confirm which we should commit to? :eyes:
Diego: Do we know which data types they actually send? PII vs pseudonymous identifiers?
Oliver (Acme): Hi! We only ever send hashed user IDs and model prompts for enrichment. No raw SSNs or DOBs. Our compliance team prefers EU only for residency, if possible.
Maya: Noted. This could surface as a renewal risk if their legal team expects EU-only and we say global. Can legal weigh in before contract sig?
LegalBot: Created ticket LR-2026-88 for review, assigning to @Diego for technical confirmation and to @Anika for operational impact. ETA 48h. :white_check_mark:
Anika: Quick ops note — EU-only routing means we need to pin their workload to eu-1 region which affects throughput and cost. We should tell Acme about a small latency bump and dedicated routing pricing.
Diego: Technical questions for Acme: 1) Are prompts sent via our hosted API or self-hosted private? 2) Do you require BYOK/KMS with key residency in EU?
Oliver (Acme): Hosted API for now. They asked about BYOK during procurement but haven't confirmed. KMS in EU would be preferred.
Maya: Okay, next steps: 1) Legal to confirm DPA checkbox language (LR-2026-88), 2) Security to confirm encryption at rest/in transit and KMS feasibility, 3) CS to present impact to Acme (latency/cost) and capture approval. I'll schedule a short call.
Diego: From security side: we support TLS in transit and AES-256 at rest. BYOK with customer-managed keys is possible on Dedicated/Private; for hosted API we can offer scoped KMS with EU key groups — need legal on residency commit.
Anika: Ops can map the routing change. If they want EU-only and BYOK, recommend Dedicated or Private. I'll draft a pricing delta.
Maya: Setting a sync for tomorrow 09:30 PT with Acme and our legal + security. @Oliver (Acme) can you confirm availability? :calendar:
Oliver (Acme): Confirmed. 09:30 PT works. We'll invite our procurement lead.
Maya: Also capturing enablement / renewal risk: I logged a renewal-risk flag on their account noting DPA residency as a blocker for signature. Renewal team please watch.
DeployBot: Reminder: documentation PR for eu-1 routing tips pending review — #pr-3124.
Diego: One more ask — can Acme provide example payload (redacted) or a short data flow diagram? Even a few lines helps.
Oliver (Acme): Here's a sanitized flow (redacted):
```
Client app -> Redwood hosted API (eu-1) -> ephemeral cache -> downstream enrichment -> S3 (eu-1, encrypted)
Metadata: hashed_user_id, prompt_text, model_response
```
Diego: Perfect, that answers the KMS/residency mapping. Will update LR ticket with recommended controls and fallback options (global if they accept additional AEs).
Maya: Thanks everyone. I'll post the call invite and the follow-up notes after legal responds. :thumbsup:
LegalBot: LR-2026-88 updated: proposed DPA amendment with optional EU-only processing clause attached. Please review at https://legal.redwood.internal/LR-2026-88
Anika: I'll attach a short ops note for the call showing perf delta and price delta.
Maya: Follow-up action items: [Maya] schedule call + send agenda, [Diego] finalize security note, [Anika] pricing delta, [Legal] sign-off or alternative language. Target: get signable DPA before EOD Fri.
Oliver (Acme): Thanks — appreciate the quick turnaround.
Maya: Closing loop — will update thread after call.
